post: Forget generic plastic ornaments. The ultimate holiday aesthetic? Red paper cutouts glowing in the window. For the Spring Festival—now an official UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage—families craft these intricate designs to celebrate reunion. It’s giving major cozy vibes. Ever tried your hand at paper cutting? ✂️
ops_tips: Pair with a high-res, moody photo of a red paper cutout backlit by warm light to nail the 'cozy aesthetic' hook.
Engage with early replies by asking followers what their favorite holiday decoration is to boost algorithm visibility.
